result.summary: The page is largely well-designed. Excluding the intentional horizontal carousel clipping and bottom viewport cutoff, one minor visual inconsistency remains: the delivery-time badges on the 'Fastest near you' cards use inconsistent background treatments (opaque white on light images vs. translucent white on dark images), which looks slightly unpolished.

issues.description: The delivery-time badges ('15–25 min', '20–30 min') on the 'Fastest near you' cards have inconsistent backgrounds: an opaque white pill on the light Green Bowl Poké image versus a semi-transparent white pill on the dark Smash Bros Burgers and Trattoria images, producing uneven contrast and a slightly unpolished look.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent badge style across all cards, e.g. a solid white (or solid dark with white text) pill with a subtle shadow, so legibility and appearance stay uniform regardless of the underlying image brightness.
